description: This source file defines classes and logic related to fetching, representing, and providing recommendations in a Flutter application. It includes data models, service classes for API interaction, and a ChangeNotifier provider for managing recommendation state.

classes.name: RecommendationItem
classes.description: Data model representing a recommendation card with fields like id, title, subtitle, call-to-action label, target route, route arguments, and optional tag. Includes a factory for JSON deserialization.

classes.name: RecommendationsService
classes.description: Service class responsible for fetching AI recommendations, either from mock data or via API calls, handling authentication token refresh as needed.

classes.name: RecommendationsProvider
classes.description: ChangeNotifier that holds and manages the list of recommendations to be displayed on the home screen, with methods for initialization and refresh.

methods.name: RecommendationItem.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a RecommendationItem instance from a JSON map, handling missing fields with defaults.

methods.name: RecommendationsService.create
methods.description: Static method to asynchronously create an instance of RecommendationsService, configured based on environment mock setting.

methods.name: RecommendationsService.fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches a list of RecommendationItem objects, either from mock data or via API, with token refresh logic included.

methods.name: RecommendationsProvider.init
methods.description: Initializes the provider by fetching recommendations; manages loading state, errors, and data updates.

methods.name: RecommendationsProvider.refresh
methods.description: Triggers re-fetching of recommendations by resetting the initialized state and calling init.
